correctness.rationale: The proof was reconstructed through countable coordinate support for product-random Boolean values, a fresh-coordinate proof that every countable-support subextension is proper, real coding of every hereditarily countable set, and the published equality V[id_G]=V[G]. The exact generating cardinal was checked in both directions: ccc plus the countable-family obstruction gives the omega_1 lower bound, and an omega_1 partition into countable coordinate blocks gives an omega_1 family of random reals generating the full extension.

originality.rationale: The ownership source states the product-random representation and whole-extension generation separately, but not the hereditary-countability obstruction. Repeated exact and semantic literature searches for the combined claim, no-real-generator formulations, and countable-support equivalents found no statement that subsumes this conclusion.

value.rationale: The result explains how one internal arithmetic element can generate a forcing extension with omega_1 independent random coordinates: the generator cannot be externally real-sized. It also computes the exact minimum size omega_1 of a generating family restricted to hereditarily countable parameters.
